meta.title: School Management System | Complete School ERP | Digithack
meta.description: Comprehensive school ERP to manage admissions, attendance, fees, communication, academics and online learning from one cloud platform.

hero.headline: Smart School Management System
hero.subLine: A complete cloud-based solution to manage admissions, students, staff, academics, communication and fees from one centralized dashboard.

blocks.title: Complete School & Institute Management
blocks.content: Our school management system is built to simplify administration and improve coordination across your institution. From admissions and attendance to online classes, exams and fee tracking, everything can be managed digitally. The system provides real-time reports, reduces manual work and ensures smooth communication between school management, teachers, students and parents.

blocks.title: Admission & Student Database
blocks.content: Easily manage student inquiries, admissions and enrollment from a single dashboard. Maintain a complete digital database including student profiles, documents, academic records and parent contact details. Front office staff can track admission progress, approvals and fee payments without paperwork.

items.title: Attendance Tracking
items.description: Track daily attendance for students and staff with automated reports and notifications for absentees.

items.title: Daily Activities
items.description: Manage classwork, homework, assignments, leaves and teacher updates for better academic coordination.

items.title: Online Classes & Exams
items.description: Conduct online classes, create exams and generate digital results with performance reports.

blocks.title: Digital Learning & Communication
blocks.content: Keep students and parents informed with instant updates, homework alerts, exam schedules and announcements. The system helps improve communication through app notifications, SMS and digital reports so everyone stays connected.

items.title: Library Management
items.description: Maintain book inventory, issue and return records, and track library usage with ease.

items.title: Transport Management
items.description: Manage bus routes, driver details and student transport assignments efficiently.

items.title: Hostel Management
items.description: Track hostel rooms, student allocations and fee records in one place.

items.title: Store & Inventory
items.description: Monitor uniforms, books, stationery and other institutional supplies with stock updates.

blocks.title: Accounts & Communication
items: Manage fee collection, expenses and financial reports from one dashboard.
Integrated payment gateway for secure online fee payments.
Send notices, reminders and announcements via mobile app and SMS.
Track pending fees and automate payment alerts to parents.

blocks.title: Reports & Insights
blocks.content: Generate detailed reports for attendance, fees, academic performance and daily activities. Access real-time dashboards to make better administrative decisions and track overall institution performance.

Digithack School Management Software is fully customizable to match your institution workflow. Whether you run a single school or multiple campuses, manage everything efficiently from one secure and scalable cloud platform.
